headline: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
summary: Apple is developing a new AI agent to perform diverse tasks. It aims to browse the web, work across apps, and write code. A job listing for a lead engineer confirms the initiative.

summary: The Brussels summit may bring new UK-EU agreements. Discussions are focusing on food, energy, and youth mobility. BBC's political editor provides an analysis of potential outcomes.

headline: Secret UK cyber operation shielded tens of thousands of fridges from hackers
summary: A covert UK cyber operation protected thousands of fridges. Supermarkets and other businesses were vulnerable to hackers. The initiative secured devices across various sectors.

headline: Massive hope for pancreatic cancer pill after trial saw tumours vanish
summary: A new daily pill, daraxonrasib, shows great promise for pancreatic cancer. Trials indicate it can shrink and even eliminate tumors. This offers significant hope against a deadly cancer.

headline: Calls for consent law change after Joanne Young rape case
summary: Joanne Young and her daughter advocate for changes to consent law. Their plea follows the details of Young's rape case. The case highlights perceived shortcomings in current legal definitions.
